VERIFIED_FACT.description: Claim backed by machine-readable evidence with SHA256 verification

HARD_LOGIC.description: Claim that follows logically from VERIFIED_FACTs or repo state

HYPOTHESIS_REQUIRES_VALIDATION.description: Claim that must be validated before use as evidence
HYPOTHESIS_REQUIRES_VALIDATION.requiredAction: Design and run validation test before use

USER_STRATEGIC_PREFERENCE.description: User-directed choice about direction, scope, or priority
USER_STRATEGIC_PREFERENCE.rule: Must be recorded as user preference, not as verified fact

CODEX_SELF_REPORT_ONLY.description: Claim from Codex natural language output, not backed by artifact
CODEX_SELF_REPORT_ONLY.rule: Cannot drive architecture; must be validated before use

REJECTED_OR_UNSUPPORTED.description: Claim that has been tested and found false, or lacks any supporting evidence
